_readme: RYL Database Ingestion Plan — structured category-by-category schedule. Each batch = 20 products. Paste the 'prompt' into ChatGPT or Gemini, get the JSON, paste it back to Claude to update the DB. 'done' flips to true once that batch is integrated.

productSchema._note: Every product must match this schema exactly
productSchema.product_name: Full Product Name as on India label
productSchema.category: FOOD | COSMETIC | PERSONAL_CARE | SUPPLEMENT | HOUSEHOLD | PET_FOOD
productSchema.sub_category: e.g. SNACKS / BEVERAGES / DAIRY / BISCUITS etc.
ingredients: in descending weight order as on India label

ingredientSchema._note: Every ingredient must match this schema exactly
ingredientSchema.function: Emulsifier / Preservative / Colour / Sweetener / Flavour Enhancer / Antioxidant / Stabiliser / Thickener / Acidity Regulator / Anti-caking Agent / Bleaching Agent
ingredientSchema.plain_explanation: One factual sentence citing FSSAI/WHO/EFSA. What it is, why it matters for Indian consumers.

condition_flags.condition: DIABETES | HYPERTENSION | HEART | KIDNEY | LIVER | THYROID | PREGNANCY | CHILD | ALLERGY

ingredientSchema.score_impact: integer: BANNED_IN_INDIA=-30, AVOID=-10, CAUTION=-3, SAFE=0, beneficial=+3 to +5
